name: Busa Listing
description: Listing factory desk: product library, platform drafts, compliance checks, claims registry, and a review queue

agentPrompts.label: What's the state of the listing pipeline?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-listing` skill in this folder, then give me the listing command-desk view — the product-by-platform status matrix, compliance pass rate, and what's ready to export this week.

agentPrompts.label: Draft listings for a product
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-listing` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then draft this product's listings across its target platforms and locales from the source material I give you, run the compliance checks, and give me the review-queue link.

agentPrompts.label: Show me what needs review
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-listing` skill in this folder, then open the review queue and summarize every draft waiting on a decision, with its compliance score and keyword-strategy notes.

agentPrompts.label: Export the approved listings
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-listing` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then export the drafts with a genuine approve decision to Markdown and a flat-file-ready listings.csv, and tell me the concrete file paths. Publishing to the marketplace itself still needs my explicit approval and happens outside this app.
